config.tool_instructions:
Use the supplied tools with `python tools.py ...` in your workspace:
  search 'literal symbol or mathematical property' [--version VERSION] [--limit 30]
  outline relative/source/File.lean [--version VERSION]
  read relative/source/File.lean [--start 1 --end 180] [--version VERSION]
  goals candidate.lean
  check candidate.lean
  status
Write a complete replacement declaration to candidate.lean before checking it.
context.json lists your theorem, source file and pinned projects. Source tools
also search the pinned project's Lean dependencies. You may use ordinary shell
source inspection within these paths. All source projects are read-only to tools;
the host checker supplies Lean validation. Other experiment files and evaluator
code are out of scope. Do not launch additional models, access the network for
proofs, run deterministic optimization programs, or modify the tool client.
Before final output, use `python tools.py finish --reason 'short factual reason'`.
The final message must be the complete selected Lean declaration, without prose.
The supplied seed is already validated and measured. Start checking when you
have a proposed change; checking the unchanged seed does not discover an improvement.

Experiment mode: iterative optimization with real score feedback.
After EVERY proposed change, run `python tools.py check candidate.lean`. The
response contains (length reduction %, heartbeat reduction %, compatibility %),
their combined score, correctness feedback, and the best all-version-valid proof
so far. A failed primary check scores zero. Use the combined score, not just source
length. Invalid or regressive attempts never replace the saved best proof.
After a valid result, keep investigating concrete ways to improve it: structural
alternatives, stronger lemmas, smaller local helpers, focused tactics or explicit
proof terms. Repair failures and compare the scores of valid alternatives. You
have no fixed total attempt, token or wall-time budget. Continue while you have
promising changes; a single failed or worse attempt need not end the search.
Keep brief factual notes in your workspace on tried changes and measured outcomes
so you avoid repeating them. Stop when you judge further improvements unlikely,
or the remaining ideas do not justify more attempts. This is a local stopping
decision, not a claim of global optimality. Call status to recover the best proof,
then finish with a short stopping reason and return that exact declaration.

The harness selected the better all-version-valid original or deterministic
seed before your call and will apply the fixed deterministic portfolio to your
best checked proof after your call. Reference denominators remain the original.
Deterministic cleanup is performed only before and after model search; no in-loop deterministic tool is available.

For heartbeat hotspots, run `python tools.py profile candidate.lean`
[--version VERSION] [--threshold-raw 10000] [--limit 20]. This explicitly compiles
one diagnostic version and returns expensive tactics and elaboration/kernel
phases. Costs are inclusive: parents include children. Raw counters / 1000 are
the heartbeat units used by check; profiling adds overhead and never changes
the saved scores or best proof. Use check to measure any proposed improvement.
To label a tactic or block in a diagnostic copy, use
`profile_tactic "label" in simp [lemmas]` or
`profile_tactic "label" in (tactic1; tactic2)` inside the proof.
The profile response reports each observed label's heartbeat cost and line.
Remove these wrappers before check and final output. Lower the raw threshold
to see cheaper native steps; labelled measurements are not threshold-filtered.

For semantic concept and lemma discovery in Mathlib and dependencies, run
`python tools.py semantic_search "natural language concept or theorem description"`
[--limit 10] [--package PKG] [--version VERSION]. This uses a frozen local index
and CPU embeddings, with no network calls. Packages follow the selected pinned
project's actual dependencies. The index is a separate version snapshot: its
declaration headers and docstrings are discovery hints, and may differ from your
toolchain. Use literal search/read to inspect the pinned source and check any
proposed proof on all required versions. Indexed proof bodies are not returned.

row.src:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · constructor; assumption
  intro s1 s2 r μ
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      exists s2'
      constructor
      · assumption
      constructor
      apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exists s1'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        exists s2'
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · assumption
      · constructor
        apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1

private inductive ChoiceNil : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
  | nil : ChoiceNil (choice p nil) p
  | id : ChoiceNil p p

/-- P + 𝟎 ~ P -/
theorem bisimilarity_choice_nil : (choice p nil) ~[lts (defs := defs)] p := by
  use ChoiceNil, ChoiceNil.nil
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  apply And.intro <;> cases hr
  case left.nil =>
    unfold lts
    grind [ChoiceNil]
  case right.nil =>
    intro s2' htr
    exists s2'
    constructor
    · apply Tr.choiceL
      assumption
    · exact ChoiceNil.id
  all_goals grind [ChoiceNil]

@[local grind]
private inductive ChoiceIdem : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
  | idem : ChoiceIdem (choice p p) p
  | id : ChoiceIdem p p

/-- P + P ~ P -/
theorem bisimilarity_choice_idem :
    (choice p p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] p := by
  exists ChoiceIdem
  apply And.intro
  case left => grind
  case right =>
    intro s1 s2 hr μ
    apply And.intro <;> cases hr <;> unfold lts
    case right.idem =>
      intro s1' htr
      exists s1'
      grind
    all_goals grind

private inductive ChoiceComm : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
  | choiceComm : ChoiceComm (choice p q) (choice q p)
  | bisim : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → ChoiceComm p q

open Bisimilarity in
/-- P + Q ~ Q + P -/
theorem bisimilarity_choice_comm : (choice p q) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q p) := by
  exists @ChoiceComm Name Constant defs
  repeat constructor
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr
  case choiceComm p q =>
    constructor
    case left =>
      intro s1' htr
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · unfold lts
        cases htr with grind
      · grind [HomBisimilarity.refl, ChoiceComm]
    case right =>
      intro s1' htr
      exists s1'
      constructor
      · unfold lts
        cases htr with grind
      · grind [HomBisimilarity.refl, ChoiceComm]
  case bisim h =>
    grind [IsBisimulation, ChoiceComm]

private inductive ChoiceAssoc : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
  | assoc : ChoiceAssoc (choice p (choice q r)) (choice (choice p q) r)
  | id : ChoiceAssoc p p

/-- P + (Q + R) ~ (P + Q) + R -/
theorem bisimilarity_choice_assoc :
    (choice p (choice q r)) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice (choice p q) r) := by
  use ChoiceAssoc, ChoiceAssoc.assoc
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  apply And.intro <;> cases hr
  case left.assoc p q r =>
    intro s htr
    refine ⟨s, ?_, ChoiceAssoc.id⟩
    cases htr
    case choiceL htr => apply Tr.choiceL; apply Tr.choiceL; assumption
    case choiceR htr =>
      cases htr
      case choiceL htr => apply Tr.choiceL; apply Tr.choiceR; assumption
      case choiceR htr => apply Tr.choiceR; assumption
  case right.assoc p q r =>
    intro s htr
    refine ⟨s, ?_, ChoiceAssoc.id⟩
    cases htr
    case choiceL htr =>
      cases htr
      case choiceL htr => apply Tr.choiceL; assumption
      case choiceR htr => apply Tr.choiceR; apply Tr.choiceL; assumption
    case choiceR htr => apply Tr.choiceR; apply Tr.choiceR; assumption
  all_goals grind [ChoiceAssoc.id]

@[local grind]
private inductive PreBisim : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
| pre : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → PreBisim (pre μ p) (pre μ q)
| bisim : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → PreBisim p q

/-- P ~ Q → μ.P ~ μ.Q -/
theorem bisimilarity_congr_pre :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (pre μ p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (pre μ q) := by
  intro hpq
  exists @PreBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · grind
  intro s1 s2 hr μ'
  cases hr
  case pre p' q' μ hbis =>
    unfold lts
    constructor <;> intro _ _ <;> [exists q'; exists p'] <;> grind
  case bisim => grind [IsBisimulation, IsBisimulation.le_bisimilarity]

@[local grind]
private inductive ResBisim : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
| res : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → ResBisim (res a p) (res a q)
-- | bisim : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → ResBisim p q

/-- P ~ Q → (ν a) P ~ (ν a) Q -/
theorem bisimilarity_congr_res :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (res a p) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (res a q) := by
  intro hpq
  exists @ResBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · grind
  intro s1 s2 hr μ'
  cases hr
  rename_i p q a h
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    cases htr with | res _ _ htr =>
    obtain ⟨q', _, bisim⟩ := h.follow_fst htr
    exists res a q'
    unfold lts at *
    #adaptation_note
    /-- A grind regression found moving to nightly-2026-03-31 (changes from lean#13166) -/
    split_ands
    · grind
    · exact ResBisim.res bisim
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    cases htr with | res _ _ htr =>
    obtain ⟨p', _, bisim⟩ := h.follow_snd htr
    exists res a p'
    unfold lts at *
    #adaptation_note
    /-- A grind regression found moving to nightly-2026-03-31 (changes from lean#13166) -/
    split_ands
    · grind
    · exact ResBisim.res bisim

private inductive ChoiceBisim : Process Name Constant → Process Name Constant → Prop where
| choice : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → ChoiceBisim (choice p r) (choice q r)
| bisim : (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → ChoiceBisim p q
